Under the Sea!
история Speak & Smile · Спики ныряет с рыбкой Finn
тапни / стрелка →
Let's explore the sea!
Mask on, fins on —
dive, dive, dive!
🦝 Come on, Finn!
I can see a whale!
A big blue whale —
hello, hello!
🐋 Blub, blub!
I can see a dolphin!
A jumping dolphin —
splish, splash!
🐬 Wheee!
I can see a crab!
A red, red crab —
snip, snip, snip!
🦀 Click, click!
I can see a jellyfish!
A pink jellyfish —
float, float, float!
🦝 So wobbly!
A SHARK!
Oh no… but the shark
just smiles: hello, friend!
🦈 Let's play!
What a day!
Speaky, Finn and all the sea —
friends under the sea!
🦝🐟 Hooray!
